definitions.explanation: The time of day right now. A common label on clocks, displays, websites, and transit information showing the present moment.

examples.japanese: {現在時刻|げんざいじこく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧です。
⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{現在時刻|げんざいじこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}される→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧。
examples.english: The current time is displayed on the screen.

examples.japanese: ⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{世界|せかい}{各地|かくち}→世界各地：24526_sekaikakuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{現在時刻|げんざいじこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}できる→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: When you open the app, you can immediately check the current time in places around the world.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧ (present, now) + ⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧ (point in time). A set phrase used wherever the present clock time is shown or announced.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現在時刻|げんざいじこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the current time
- {現在時刻|げんざいじこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}する→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧: to display the current time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧: point in time — a specific moment on the clock, not necessarily the present one
- ⟦{現時点|げんじてん}→現時点：13556_genjiten⟧: the present point — refers to "as of now" in a broader sense, not just the clock time
